lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery
strengths: The frozen executable evidence passes 13 of 13 core tests on iPhone 17 Pro Simulator and 2 of 2 compact visual tests on iPhone SE, both on iOS 26.5.
The original horizontal-gesture conflict is resolved: row swipe keeps its destination, content-wide swipe no longer navigates, and only the top controls select Today, Sessions, or People.
Transient action recovery is directly covered across active-tab reselection, another row, another destination, vertical scrolling, global Ask, and background and foreground.
The previous scroll-continuity risk is resolved for tested paths with 50-item fixtures and per-destination anchors that remain within one row.
Multiple-context People Ask blocks Send and backend requests until the recruiter explicitly selects one visible relationship for that person.
Session deletion is staged, truthful, cancelable, device-local, and transactionally recoverable on persistence failure.
Thirty warmed samples pass both Simulator readiness gates and the report is cryptographically bound to the frozen App dylib.

Small-iPhone light and Simplified Chinese dark AX5 Reduce Motion screenshots retain identity, context, provenance, 44-point controls, and a calm hierarchy without row chevrons, the unwanted vertical divider, or redundant page copy.
missing_evidence: not_run: physical-device touch ergonomics, context-menu haptic feel, touch-to-photon latency, frame pacing, energy use, and Low Power Mode behavior.
not_run: human VoiceOver, Switch Control, and Full Keyboard Access completion and focus restoration for the complete Session and People loops.
not_run: the oldest supported iOS 16 runtime, RTL, increased contrast, reduce transparency, 200-percent localization expansion, and landscape where supported.
not_run: a repeated physical short, medium, full, slow, fast, and diagonal gesture matrix.
not_run: localized deletion and failure alerts in Simplified Chinese dark AX5 with VoiceOver.
not_run: blinded recruiter testing for findability, reconstruction time, interruption cost, and continued-use preference.
open_questions: Should the performance gate add a maximum or p99 threshold, given one of thirty Session-open samples reached 1,361.06 ms while p95 passed?
Will the same native swipe arbitration, scroll restoration, and accessibility focus behavior remain stable on iOS 16 and representative physical devices?
